definitions.full: H7578. retheth רְתֵת noun [masculine] trembling (on form Lag BN 176 Ba § 7 b ); — ׳ר Hosea 13:1 (si versa l.) when Ephraim spoke trembling (AV Che and others) Ew and others spoke terror ; Hi Ke Rv spoke , there was trembling ; text dubious (see Now).
